data.title: Crypto Market Bloodbath: Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP Crash Up to 10% as Bear Market Fears Grow
data.description: Bitcoin dropped below $56,000 on Saturday, and Ethereum and XRP fell with it. BTC is trading at $55,693, down 8.9% in a day and 16.2% in a week. Ethereum
